summary_oneline: add_semantic for DatasetManager is feasible as a governed-per-fetch DataSource shipped from ai-parrot-semantic; the DuckDB store is a separate feature.

constraints.statement: Dependency direction: ai-parrot-semantic depends on ai-parrot; nothing in core or tools imports parrot.semantic
constraints.implication: the semantic source class must ship from ai-parrot-semantic and be registered through add_source(), or DatasetManager must import it lazily inside add_semantic (as it does querysource)

constraints.statement: engines.compile output is pre-governance SQL; the toolkit never hands governed SQL to callers and _run_governed is the single path to rows
constraints.implication: a source that stores compiled SQL in a plain SQLQuerySource skips usage rights, model RLS, masks, limits and audit - a governance bypass

constraints.statement: The existing hand-off deliberately keeps governed rows out of a raw or shared DatasetManager (owner 4-tuple, expiry, re-authorization on every read)
constraints.implication: a pull-direction source must not undercut M9H: governed rows may not be materialized once and served to other subjects

constraints.statement: DatasetManager's cache is subject-less: entry._df in memory plus Redis Parquet keyed only by source.cache_key, shared across agents
constraints.implication: a source whose rows depend on the caller must set has_builtin_cache = True (or no_cache) and must not be served from a shared entry across subjects

constraints.statement: AuthorizingDataSource dispatches by isinstance; an unknown source class gets the opaque resolver and no RLS, a missing PermissionContext fails open, and a sensitive driver rejects every non-QuerySlugSource
constraints.implication: a new source class must either be taught to resolver / RLS injection or own its governance and be excluded from double-wrapping; RLS from the shared (driver, table) registry must not be injected twice

constraints.statement: A LoadedModel only exists after SemanticModelLoader(models_dir, driver).load(), which requires a policy side-file per model
constraints.implication: add_semantic takes a models directory (model + policy), not one stand-alone YAML file

constraints.statement: The compiler needs a full SemanticQuery and always appends LIMIT min(query.limit or limits.default, limits.max), defaults 1000 / 10000
constraints.implication: a semantic dataset is a query result (metrics x dimensions x filters), never 'the whole model', and is row-capped unless the policy raises limits.max

constraints.statement: Driver naming and execution differ: DatasetManager uses asyncdb names (pg) and AsyncDB -> DataFrame; the semantic layer uses the toolkit dialect string, PARROT_SEMANTIC_CONN_* overlays and DatabaseQueryToolkit -> row dicts with a limit+1 probe row
constraints.implication: PBAC resource ids (<driver>:<schema.table>) only match on both sides if names are normalized; whoever executes governed SQL must drop the probe row and build the DataFrame
compiled SQL containing literal braces cannot be passed through SQLQuerySource unchanged

constraints.statement: No DuckDB-backed dataset store exists; nine accessors and the pandas REPL hand-over read entry._df directly; FEAT-713 (draft) already decided 'one compiler, two execution targets' with DuckDB + Arrow and lists modifying DatasetManager as a non-goal
constraints.implication: a DuckDB-backed store is a cross-cutting DatasetManager change independent of the semantic source and must be reconciled with FEAT-713 rather than designed twice

constraints.statement: Both areas are quiet: DatasetManager had 3 hardening commits in 45 days, the semantic package no source change since 2026-10-30, no branch combines them; FEAT-742 may later replace the compiler
constraints.implication: low collision risk; depend on engines.compile, not on NativeCompiler directly

new: SemanticDataSource (DataSource subclass) shipped from ai-parrot-semantic: holds models_dir + dialect + a pinned SemanticQuery, compiles through engines.compile and governs through GovernancePipeline on every fetch under the caller's PermissionContext, returns a DataFrame; has_builtin_cache = True and a cache_key that never crosses subjects

A registration entry point: DatasetManager.add_semantic(...) with a lazy import of the semantic distribution (clear error when it is not installed), or a helper in ai-parrot-semantic that calls add_source()
A small internal semantic API that returns governed SQL (or governed rows) to a trusted in-process source without going through the LLM-facing toolkit tools
Tests in packages/ai-parrot-semantic/tests (source contract, per-subject isolation, no shared cache, probe-row trimming) plus a DatasetManager registration test
Separate feature: a DuckDB-backed dataset store behind DatasetEntry (not part of the semantic source)

factor the govern-and-execute core so a source can reuse it without the tool surface (no behavior change for the toolkit)

untouched: The LLM-facing semantic tools and the existing push hand-off (save_result_as_dataset, GovernedDatasetSink) keep their contract

parrot/clients/base.py and every other DataSource kind

patterns.pattern: One DataSource subclass per source kind plus one add_* method; add_source() already accepts any pre-built source

risks.risk: Governance bypass if compiled (pre-governance) SQL is executed by a plain SQLQuerySource
risks.impact: masks, usage grants, model RLS, limits and audit are skipped; mitigate by governing inside fetch()

risks.risk: Cross-subject leakage through entry._df or the Redis Parquet cache
risks.impact: one subject's governed rows served to another; mitigate with has_builtin_cache = True and a manager that is per session / owner, or a subject-keyed cache

risks.risk: Double RLS injection (semantic pipeline + AuthorizingDataSource share the (driver, table) registry)
risks.impact: duplicated predicates or refusals; mitigate by declaring the source self-governed

risks.risk: Driver-name mismatch (pg vs postgres) changes PBAC resource ids
risks.impact: grants silently do not match; normalize once

risks.risk: Policy row cap (1000 default / 10000 max) truncates analytical datasets
risks.impact: silently partial DataFrame; surface truncation and let the policy raise limits.max
two designs for the same engine; reconcile in one spec

confidence_map.statement: A new source kind needs no change to DatasetManager's registration machinery: add_source() registers any DataSource
Datasets are in-memory pandas DataFrames (entry._df) with a subject-less Redis Parquet cache; DatasetManager has no DuckDB store
confidence_map.reasoning: materialize / _cache_df read; duckdb grep shows only dialect map and Delta/Iceberg engines

confidence_map.statement: The semantic layer can compile without identity or connection via engines.compile, but that SQL is pre-governance
governed: false only skips PBAC and the connection requirement; usage rights, RLS, masking and the limit guard still run
Executing compiled SQL through a plain SQLQuerySource would bypass masks, usage grants, model RLS, limits and audit
confidence_map.reasoning: follows directly from C3 plus the absence of masking / member rights in AuthorizingDataSource

confidence_map.statement: The existing hand-off is push-only and forbids a raw DatasetManager as the holder of governed rows
The source class must live in ai-parrot-semantic or be lazily imported, because core cannot depend on the semantic distribution
confidence_map.reasoning: pyproject dependencies + grep for parrot.semantic imports in core/tools returned none

confidence_map.statement: A semantic dataset must pin (or receive) a full SemanticQuery and is row-capped by the policy limits
confidence_map.reasoning: compiler requirements and LIMIT clause read directly

confidence_map.statement: A governed-per-fetch SemanticDataSource registered through add_source is implementable with existing pieces in one spec of roughly TASK-431 size plus authz integration
confidence_map.reasoning: all pieces exist, but the govern-and-execute core is currently private to the toolkit and the authz wrapper needs a defined behavior for the new class; sizing is by precedent

confidence_map.statement: DatasetManager can execute governed SQL itself (AsyncDB -> DataFrame) provided driver names are normalized and the limit probe row is trimmed
confidence_map.reasoning: credential dict shapes are compatible; not exercised end to end, and SQLQuerySource's str.format interpolation cannot be reused as-is

confidence_map.statement: Whether one DatasetManager instance is shared across users or sessions in production hosts decides whether entry._df itself leaks across subjects
confidence_map.reasoning: the hand-off assumes shared managers exist; instance scoping in handlers was not researched

confidence_map.statement: A DuckDB-backed store is a separate, cross-cutting DatasetManager feature that overlaps FEAT-713
confidence_map.reasoning: nine direct _df accessors plus the pandas REPL hand-over; FEAT-713 is draft and its premise is stale

confidence_map.statement: Collision risk is low: no in-flight work combines DatasetManager and the semantic layer

ungoverned only: accept only models without masks / RLS / member grants and let DatasetManager's own authz apply
unknowns.user_answer: Governed per fetch (compile + GovernancePipeline under the caller's identity, never cached across subjects)

semantic Executor runs it and the source converts rows to a DataFrame
